main_topic.h_title: Feeling overwhelmed or unsure about next steps?
main_topic.main_title: Feeling overwhelmed or unsure about next steps?

primary_content.text: Whether you're considering a new business or rethinking an existing one,
clarity doesn't come from rushing to decisions. It comes from slowing down
enough to think clearly.
I work with women in business who want clarity without pressure;
practical structure, and, when the time is right,
a clear one-page business plan.

primary_content.text: I can help bring peace and power to you and your business…

main_topic.main_title: Feeling overwhelmed or unsure about next steps?

primary_content.text: Who this is for
This work is designed for entrepreneurial women who feel capable but unclear about what to build next in their business.
What we focus on
We focus on clarifying your business direction, simplifying strategy, and aligning your business with who you are now.
How the Reboot Framework works
The Reboot Framework uses structured reflection, clear decisions, and practical planning so you leave with a focused next step and a clear business direction.
After this work, you stop circling the same questions and start moving forward with clarity and confidence.

main_topic.h_title: In business I’ve had many roles and titles.
main_topic.main_title: Feeling overwhelmed or unsure about next steps?

primary_content.text: Yes, I’ve been an employee, employer, contractor, entrepreneur, solopreneur, and partner. I learned many things. And sometimes I had to unlearn and relearn things. I just considered it a reboot each time.
I’m resilient and so are you. I've left corporate life twice to start my own business...lots of learning there, especially when it comes to gaining clarity and making grounded business decisions.
I’m a licensed affiliate of the One Page Business Plan Company and have been for many years.

primary_content.text: Compassionate, supportive, resilient, and knowledgeable, with a balance of cheerleading and a gentle challenge when it's needed…all designed to get you where you want to go.

main_topic.main_title: I've become the business coach I wish I had.

primary_content.text: I know what it’s like to reboot you and your business. I’ve done it more than once. Whether you call it restart, rewire, refresh…it’s all about tweaking what you’re doing and starting again. And that’s about being resilient.

In the communication business for over 35 years, my focus has always been on plain language. I'm a Premier Success Coach with eWomen Network. I’ve also been a business analyst, drawing process maps (flowcharts) that go around a room to connect the dots on how things work so we can simplify them. I’ve taught a web usability course at the University of Toronto. I’m a Mary Kay Independent Beauty Consultant. And just to lighten things up, I'm a Laughter Yoga leader.

main_topic.h_title: How it all started…and why I do this work
main_topic.main_title: I've become the business coach I wish I had.

primary_content.text: Who would have thought that a psychology degree and working at a dairy would have led me here? But it did. I’ve always been open to the changes and challenges life can present.
I studied NLP (Neuro Linguistic Programming) because I’ve always been curious about how our minds work and how awareness influences choice and behaviour.

I love helping women in business. I've been a director with my local Chamber of Commerce, the president of a business women's networking group, the president (and many other roles) of the Toronto chapter of the STC (Society for Technical Communication). I'm currently on the communications committee for the Plain Language Federation (a global initiative). There's also been local leadership roles - Chair of the Farmers' Market, President of the horticultural society, the downtown revitalization committee, Communications Chair for our village association, and for the last 6 years, I've hosted an outdoor art show on my property.

I had a writing company with a team of 8 which I had to let go when incoming jobs came to a standstill despite all our efforts. I contracted my services as a solopreneur and worked onsite in California, and in Breda, The Netherlands.

It was those contracting assignments where my clients would say what a great coaching style I had. A little surprised, I said that’s just my way to work with people. I never thought of it as coaching, but it was. Heaven knows I hired a few coaches over the years, but they weren’t what I needed. And that’s when I decided to become the business coach I wish I had.

main_topic.main_title: I've become the business coach I wish I had.

primary_content.text: Carolyn is a very experienced and knowledgeable business coach. She is easy to talk to, empathetic, and provides relevant and actionable support where it’s necessary. I will definitely be coming back to Carolyn for
future business development guidance!

Carolyn is an exceptional coach and mentor with a wealth of knowledge about content design, UX research, communications and copywriting. She’s an inspiring leader who helps everyone on her team reach their full potential.
Fan-Yee Suen, content writer
Carolyn and I worked on my "One Page Business Plan" together. What great results! It's helped me focus on not
only what I needed to do but also what my business had to offer. Thanks Carolyn, you made a great difference
in my daily and future plans.
Karen Strumos, owner Divine Energy Membership

main_topic.main_title: Conversation...Courage...Clarity

primary_content.text: I work with women who want to think clearly about their business—without rushing decisions or following formulas that don’t fit.

Whether you’re exploring an idea, reshaping an existing business, or navigating a transition, there are different ways we can work together depending on your readiness, pace, and the level of support you want.
All of my work is grounded in thoughtful conversation, practical structure, and respect for adult decision-making.

main_topic.main_title: Conversation...Courage...Clarity

primary_content.text: The 4-Week Reboot Series is a structured, facilitated experience for women who want to reset how they think about their business and move forward with clarity.

This is not a high-pressure programme or rapid strategy sprint. It is a deliberate process built around the Reboot framework, designed to help you pause, reflect, and rebuild your thinking in a way that aligns with who you are now.
Over four consecutive weeks, we move through the Reboot process together:
Rest — Create space to step back from urgency and noise.
Reflect — Clarify what matters now and what no longer does.
Reimagine — Explore possibilities without rushing into decisions.
Rewrite — Translate insight into a simple, workable direction.
Each session builds on the last to support continuity, trust, and meaningful progress.
This experience is well suited to women who are starting, reshaping, or simplifying a business and want structure not overwhelm.

main_topic.main_title: Conversation...Courage...Clarity

primary_content.text: - Four consecutive weekly sessions
- 90 minutes per facilitated conversation - Small group (up to six women)
USD pricing available at checkout
After completing the 4-Week Reboot Series, women may continue in the Rebooters Community for ongoing group support, or work with me individually for deeper strategic guidance.

main_topic.main_title: Conversation...Courage...Clarity

primary_content.text: Group coaching is for women who are ready to move from reflection into structure. This is a guided, time-bound process designed to help you build or refine a clear, grounded one-page business plan.

In this small-group setting, we work through the core elements of your plan together—purpose, priorities, direction, and next steps—with thoughtful facilitation and shared learning. You benefit not only from your own thinking, but from hearing how others are approaching similar decisions.

Group coaching is well suited to women who have clarity about their direction and are ready to put structure around it, without rushing or oversimplifying. The outcome of this work is a practical, usable one-page business plan that reflects both your business goals and the life you want it to support.

main_topic.main_title: Conversation...Courage...Clarity

primary_content.text: - 90-day group coaching container
- Up to 10 facilitated group sessions
This timeframe allows for depth, reflection, and progress, recognizing that clarity unfolds at different paces for different women.
The focus is not speed, but sound thinking and decisions you can stand behind.
USD pricing available at checkout

main_topic.main_title: Conversation...Courage...Clarity

primary_content.text: Individual coaching is for women who want a dedicated thinking partner focused entirely on their context. This option is designed for situations that involve complexity, transition, or the need for privacy and depth.

Working one-to-one allows us to move at your pace and respond to what emerges, while still maintaining clear structure and forward momentum. Together, we explore your goals, constraints, and priorities, and translate them into a clear, grounded one-page business plan.

Individual coaching is particularly helpful when your business or life circumstances don’t fit neatly into a group setting, or when you want tailored support as you make thoughtful, significant decisions.

main_topic.main_title: Conversation...Courage...Clarity

primary_content.text: Individual coaching is typically offered in a 90-day private container that includes structured sessions, reflection between meetings, and development of a clear one-page business plan.
USD pricing available at checkout
Additional ongoing or session-based support may be available by conversation.

primary_content.text: Who this is for
This work is designed for entrepreneurial women who feel capable but unclear about what to build next in their business.
What we focus on
We focus on clarifying your business direction, simplifying strategy, and aligning your business with who you are now.
How the Reboot Framework works
The Reboot Framework uses structured reflection, clear decisions, and practical planning so you leave with a focused next step and a clear business direction.
After this work, you stop circling the same questions and start moving forward with clarity and confidence.

main_topic.h_title: In business I’ve had many roles and titles.
main_topic.main_title: Feeling overwhelmed or unsure about next steps?

primary_content.text: Yes, I’ve been an employee, employer, contractor, entrepreneur, solopreneur, and partner. I learned many things. And sometimes I had to unlearn and relearn things. I just considered it a reboot each time.
I’m resilient and so are you. I've left corporate life twice to start my own business...lots of learning there, especially when it comes to gaining clarity and making grounded business decisions.
I’m a licensed affiliate of the One Page Business Plan Company and have been for many years.

main_topic.main_title: Insight 1

primary_content.text: Clarity isn't usually a time problem.
We often look for better answers, when what we really need are better questions.
What am I assuming to be true?
What actually matters here?
Without that pause, it's easy to move quickly in the wrong direction.
Strong decisions don't come from more input. They come from stepping back long enough to see clearly.

main_topic.main_title: Insight 1

primary_content.text: Lately, I've been noticing something.
People aren't just looking for answers. They're looking for a space to think.
And perhaps just as importantly, space to notice when something is read to be said...or not.
In thoughtful conversation, something shifts. Not because someone provides the answer, but because there is room to reflect, to hear your own thinking more clearly, and to consider what matters now.
Clarity doesn't come from pressure. It comes from creating the conditions where thinking can unfold.

main_topic.h_title: Clarity and the courage to choose
main_topic.main_title: Insight 1

primary_content.text: Clarity is something many people say they want.
But in practice, it's often something they avoid.
Because clarity asks for decisions.
It asks us to choose.
And once we choose, we also have to let go of evrything else.
So instead, we stay in preparation.
All useful - until they become a place to hide.
Clarity doesn't arrive fully formed.
It emerges through movement.
Through the willingness to see what's actually there - not what we hoped would be.
